code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 3)]
    blank_crosses = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] == 0 and r > 0 and r + 1 < h and c > 0 and c + 1 < w
                     and grid[r-1][c] == grid[r+1][c] == grid[r][c-1] == grid[r][c+1] == 3]
    blocked_rows = {r for r, c in blank_crosses}
    blocked_cols = {c for r, c in blank_crosses}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c, color in centers:
        for dr, dc in ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)):
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            distance = 1
            while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
                value = grid[nr][nc]
                if value != 0 and not (distance == 1 and value == 3):
                    break
                if value == 0 and nr not in blocked_rows and nc not in blocked_cols:
                    out[nr][nc] = color
                nr += dr
                nc += dc
                distance += 1
    return out
'''
